title: UniRate Currency Exchange Rates & EU VAT Rates — Open Dataset
description:
An open, regularly-updated dataset of foreign-exchange rates for 885+ currencies (fiat and cryptocurrency) quoted against USD, EUR and GBP, together with the standard VAT rate for every EU member state.

All figures are sourced from the free UniRate API — a free currency exchange-rate and VAT API covering 170+ fiat currencies and major cryptocurrencies. Grab a free API key and read the documentation at https://unirateapi.com.

Contents

  • data/exchange-rates.csv — long-format FX table, one row per (base, currency) pair for the USD, EUR and GBP bases (~2,655 rows).
  • data/eu-vat-rates.csv — standard VAT rate per EU member state.

The dataset is packaged as a Frictionless Data Package (datapackage.json) and is fully reproducible with the included curl/jq script — no package manager, no build step, no third-party dependencies. It refreshes daily from the UniRate API via GitHub Actions. Only free-tier endpoints are used (GET /api/rates and GET /api/vat/rates).

Released into the public domain. Attribution to UniRate API is appreciated but not required.
notes: Data sourced from the free UniRate API (https://unirateapi.com). Only free-tier endpoints are used: GET /api/rates and GET /api/vat/rates. Canonical repository releases the data under the Open Data Commons PDDL-1.0 (public domain).
